projects.name: Childress site
projects.quote: Our 750MW Childress site has been operating since April 2023 and, as of June 30, 2025, has approximately 650MW of operating data center capacity and installed hashrate capacity of approximately 40.1 EH/s.

projects.name: Horizon 1
projects.quote: We are currently undertaking an expansion of our data center capacity at Childress to support a direct-to-chip liquid cooling deployment known as “Horizon 1” with an IT load of up to 50MW (based on rack density of up to 200kW, subject to customer requirements) targeting energization by the end of calendar year 2025 for potential growth opportunities for HPC and AI services.

projects.name: Sweetwater 1
projects.quote: Our 1,400MW Sweetwater 1 and 600MW Sweetwater 2 sites are under development and located approximately 40 miles from Abilene, Texas.

projects.name: Sweetwater 2
projects.quote: Our 1,400MW Sweetwater 1 and 600MW Sweetwater 2 sites are under development and located approximately 40 miles from Abilene, Texas.

projects.name: Prince George site
projects.quote: Our Prince George site has been operating since September 2022 and, as of June 30, 2025, had approximately 50MW of data center capacity and hashrate capacity of approximately 3.1 EH/s.

projects.name: Mackenzie site
projects.quote: Our Mackenzie site has been operating since April 2022 and, as of June 30, 2025, had approximately 80MW of data center capacity and hashrate capacity of approximately 5.2 EH/s.

projects.name: Canal Flats site
projects.quote: Our Canal Flats site was acquired from PodTech Innovation Inc. and certain of its related parties in January 2020, and has been operating since 2019.

projects.name: Prince George GPU fleet expansion (B200, B300, GB300)
projects.quote: Subsequent to June 30, 2025 we procured, through a combination of purchases and equipment leasing, approximately 5.5k NVIDIA B200 GPUs, 2.3k NVIDIA B300 GPUs and 1.2k NVIDIA GB300 GPUs to be installed at our Prince George site by the end of calendar year 2025, that will bring the total GPU fleet to approximately 10.9k NVIDIA GPUs.

projects.name: July 2025 NVIDIA B200/B300 GPU purchase order (Prince George)
projects.quote: On July 3, 2025 we announced that we entered into a purchase order with respect to an additional approximately 1.3k NVIDIA B200 GPUs and 1.1k NVIDIA B300 GPUs for a total purchase price of approximately $130 million, which are to be delivered by the end of calendar year 2025 and installed at our Prince George site.

projects.name: August 2025 NVIDIA B200 GPU purchase order (Prince George)
projects.quote: Further in August 2025, we entered into a purchase order with respect to an additional approximately 4.2k NVIDIA B200 GPUs for a total purchase price of approximately $193 million and entered into a further purchase agreement for approximately 1.2k NVIDIA B300 GPUs for a total purchase price of approximately $71.4 million.

projects.name: August 2025 NVIDIA B300 GPU purchase agreement (Prince George)
projects.quote: Further in August 2025, we entered into a purchase order with respect to an additional approximately 4.2k NVIDIA B200 GPUs for a total purchase price of approximately $193 million and entered into a further purchase agreement for approximately 1.2k NVIDIA B300 GPUs for a total purchase price of approximately $71.4 million.

projects.name: NVIDIA GB300 GPU equipment lease (Prince George)
projects.quote: Further, on August 28, 2025 we entered into an arrangement pursuant to which we secured approximately $96 million in financing to support the acquisition of approximately 1.2k NVIDIA GB300 GPUs.
